question.problem: Which of the following is a representation of the set $S=\{-2,1,2\}\times [0,2]$ in the Cartesian plane?
question.worked_solution:
The Cartesian product $A\times B$ consists of all ordered pairs whose first coordinate belongs to $A$ and whose second coordinate belongs to $B.$

$$
A\times B=\{(a,b)\,:\,a\in A,\,b\in B\}
$$

In this case, the set 

$$
S=\{-2,1,2\}\times [0,2]
$$

contains every point in ${R}^{2}$ whose $x$-coordinate is either $-2,1,$ or $2$ and whose $y$-coordinate is any real number in the interval $[0,2].$

$$
S=\{(x,y)\,:\,x\in \{-2,1,2\},\,y\in [0,2]\}.
$$

To visualize $S$, consider ${S}_{1}⊂S$ containing all points whose $x$-coordinate equals $-2$ and whose $y$-coordinate is any real number in the interval $[0,2].$

$$
{S}_{1}=\{(-2,y)\,:\,y\in [0,2]\}
$$

This set is represented by the line segment shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14242415/assets/449b948df4a32c540281ddac1659c261e2908433ecc1f383b26cb5cb4aa29756.png)

Next, consider ${S}_{2}⊂S$ containing all points whose $x$-coordinate equals $1$ and whose $y$-coordinate is any real number in the interval $[0,2].$

$$
{S}_{2}=\{(1,y)\,:\,y\in [0,2]\}.
$$

This set is represented by the line segment shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14242415/assets/922c96e62e8ed3481e595595e060956fbaf191cd3ec7636e7a874b11fea3bcd5.png)

Now, consider ${S}_{3}⊂S$ containing all points whose $x$-coordinate equals $2$ and whose $y$-coordinate is any real number in the interval $[0,2].$

$$
{S}_{2}=\{(2,y)\,:\,y\in [0,2]\}.
$$

This set is represented by the line segment shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14242415/assets/0d3cb62f7e9fb47823d0a2ba8c071e09adbea673ad54a5d1b014e8882aeff472.png)

Our Cartesian product is the *union* of these subsets:

$$
S={S}_{1}\cup {S}_{2}\cup {S}_{3}
$$

Therefore, $S$ can be represented by the three line segments shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14242415/assets/f7cecda03e84263537cb29bbd14bb4dccc2e60fada10db1ca96798490e978676.png)
